entries.title: SSH Port Open to All Internet
entries.description: The deployment declares a public address, exposed ports, or broad inbound access. Resolve effective routes, firewall rules, listening services, and authentication.
entries.impact: If a sensitive service is reachable from an untrusted network, remote actors may attempt credential attacks or exploit reachable service defects. A public address or image EXPOSE declaration alone does not establish internet reachability.
entries.remediation: Restrict inbound access to required services and trusted networks. Keep management and database endpoints private where possible, and verify actual listening ports, firewall rules, and access controls.
entries.reviewer: SSH open to 0.0.0.0/0 is a critical finding. Verify no legitimate use case requires public SSH access. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

entries.title: S3 Bucket Publicly Accessible
entries.description: Storage configuration may permit public object access. Resolve bucket or container policies, object ACLs, and provider-level public-access controls.
entries.impact: Unauthenticated users may read private objects or modify publicly writable content if effective access rules grant those operations. A permissive account-level option alone does not establish that every object is public.
entries.remediation: Disable unnecessary public access, enforce narrow identity-based permissions, and verify effective object access from an unauthenticated client. Separate intentionally public content from private storage.
entries.reviewer: Confirm public S3 access is intentional and that bucket contents are appropriate for public exposure. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

entries.title: Storage Encryption Disabled or Not Configured
entries.description: Storage encryption is disabled or not established by the checked configuration. Resolve provider defaults and the effective deployed encryption policy.
entries.impact: Someone who obtains unauthorized access to underlying storage or snapshots may recover private records without the intended encryption-at-rest boundary.
entries.remediation: Enable appropriate storage and snapshot encryption with controlled key access. Verify the effective deployed state and plan migration of existing unencrypted data.
entries.reviewer: Confirm all storage resources have encryption configured. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

entries.title: CloudTrail Logging Disabled
entries.description: The code writes diagnostic data or exposes detailed errors. Establish the values emitted, production configuration, and recipients of the output.
entries.impact: Readers of exposed diagnostics may obtain credentials, private records, internal paths, or implementation details that enable account misuse or targeted attacks.
entries.remediation: Keep sensitive values and detailed errors out of user-facing responses and routine logs. Redact before emission, restrict diagnostic access, and verify production logging configuration.
entries.reviewer: Confirm CloudTrail is enabled and covers all regions and management events. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

entries.title: VPC Flow Logs Disabled
entries.description: Network flow logging is disabled in the checked configuration. Resolve any equivalent telemetry and coverage.
entries.impact: Missing traffic evidence may delay detection and limit investigation of unauthorized connections or data exfiltration; disabling this log does not itself grant network access.
entries.remediation: Enable appropriately scoped flow telemetry or equivalent monitoring, protect log access and retention, and test alerts for relevant anomalous traffic.
entries.reviewer: Confirm VPC flow logging is enabled and logs are being captured. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

entries.title: Hardcoded Secret or Password in Terraform Variables
entries.description: The checked source or build configuration embeds potentially sensitive credential or key material. Determine whether it is active and whether it reaches distributed artifacts or logs.
entries.impact: A party who can read exposed source, artifacts, configuration, or logs may recover active secrets and access the protected service or decrypt data with the secret owner’s privileges.
entries.remediation: Remove active secrets from source and build layers, rotate exposed values, and load replacements through a restricted secret-management facility. Use narrowly privileged, short-lived credentials.
entries.reviewer: Confirm all credential values reference variables or data sources, not literal strings. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
